bio.text: Henry Genga has been State Representative for East Hartford's 10th Assembly District since 2006 and is Majority Whip at Large.
Genga holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Hartford and a master's degree in education from the University of New Haven.
Genga worked as a senior information systems analyst at The Travelers from 1974 to 1994, then as a business education instructor at East Hartford High School from 1996 to 2007.
Genga served on the East Hartford Town Council from 1975 to 1985 and again from 2003 to 2006, and was town treasurer from 1985 to 1997.
